dedupe_keys.name: meti electric power survey statistics 電力調査統計 monthly power plants generation demand and fuel use in japan

description: The Electric Power Survey Statistics of the Agency for Natural Resources and Energy clarify each month the demand, generation and fuel consumption of the Japanese electricity business, compiled from the monthly generation and receipt reports that electricity businesses submit. The survey began in 1951 and has been collected under the electricity reporting rules since June 1965; its content changed substantially from April 2016 after the electricity business law reform. Tables by fiscal year, from 2014 to 2025 on the archive page, cover the number and capacity of power plants of electricity businesses and by prefecture (added from April 2019), generation and generation by prefecture, electricity demand and demand by prefecture, thermal fuel use, private generation, and demand and reverse power flow by municipality, as Excel files with a PDF summary; machine-readable layouts of tables 1 to 4 were added from October 2020. The page was last updated on 11 September 2026 with fiscal 2025 data. Coverage is Japan. Files are free; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the 2016 change breaks series continuity, and corrections are published in a separate file. Simulation uses are prefecture and municipal demand and generation inputs for capacity and energy system models. Related records: data-tohoku-nw-area-demand-supply-records gives hourly regional data.
